تختبرين (form VIII)
# تَخْتَبِرِينَ (taḵtabirīna) /tax.ta.bi.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَبَرَ (iḵtabara)
# تُخْتَبَرِينَ (tuḵtabarīna) /tux.ta.ba.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَبَرَ (iḵtabara)
